checkpoints.name: Change default log directory from /tmp to ./logs in repo
checkpoints.scope: Update safety.default_log_dir to default to ./logs in the repository directory (using repo_root() / 'logs' if inside a git repository, or relative Path('logs') as fallback, while maintaining LOG_DIR environment variable override). Ignore logs/ directory in .gitignore.
exit_criteria: default_log_dir returns repo_root() / 'logs' when inside a git repository and LOG_DIR is unset
default_log_dir respects LOG_DIR env var when set
checkpoints.review_notes: Touched src/agent_loop/safety.py, .gitignore, and this checkpoint file. No tests added (test coverage is reserved for phase2); manually verified the repository default and LOG_DIR override. default_log_dir now returns repo_root() / 'logs' when LOG_DIR is unset in a Git repo, returns Path(LOG_DIR) when set, and logs/ is ignored.

checkpoints.name: Enhance log output with agent traces, commit statements, review comments, and approval comments
checkpoints.scope: Update orchestrator and git_ops to explicitly print structured log entries for agent traces (start/finish/prompts), commit statements (messages and commit hashes), review comments, and approval comments so they are captured by safety.tee_stdout_to in the log file.
exit_criteria: Logs include explicit agent trace statements for developer and reviewer runs
Logs include explicit commit statements with commit status and commit hashes
Logs include explicit review comments when review is completed
Logs include explicit approval comments when checkpoints are approved
checkpoints.review_notes: Touched src/agent_loop/orchestrator.py, src/agent_loop/git_ops.py, and this checkpoint file. Tests added: none (reserved for phase2); existing focused orchestrator/CLI tests pass (57 passed). AGENT_TRACE JSON lines record developer and reviewer start, prompt, and finish events; COMMIT_STATEMENT JSON lines record no-change or committed status, message, and commit hash; REVIEW_COMMENT logs the completed review status and notes; APPROVAL_COMMENT logs approval status and notes for reviewer approvals and already-approved checkpoints.

checkpoints.name: Update tests and verify functionality
checkpoints.scope: Add and update unit tests for safety.default_log_dir, orchestrator logging, and git_ops commit statements. Ensure all pytest tests pass cleanly.
exit_criteria: Unit tests verify default_log_dir behavior with and without LOG_DIR env var and inside git repo
Unit tests verify agent traces, commit statements, review comments, and approval comments in orchestrator output
The full test suite (python3 -m pytest) passes
checkpoints.review_notes: Touched tests/test_safety.py, tests/test_git_ops.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py, and this checkpoint file. Added coverage for LOG_DIR override, repository-root logs default, and outside-repository fallback; structured developer/reviewer AGENT_TRACE events plus REVIEW_COMMENT, APPROVAL_COMMENT, and commit event output; and committed/no-change COMMIT_STATEMENT payloads including messages and hashes. Full suite passes: python3 -m pytest (217 passed).
